metadata.description: Specifies the tenant primary domain name (don't put the GUID, only the FQDN Name) that will be audited (Name of Azure AD Tenant where Automation Account is deployed).
Specifies the tenant ID (Put the GUID only) that will be audited.
Specifies the Azure Monitor data collection endpoint URI.
Specifies the immutable ID of the Azure Monitor data collection rule.
Specifies the name of the data collection rule in the deployment resource group.
Specifies the tenant ID used to ingest logs into Azure Monitor.
Specifies the location in which to create the workspace.
Enter new GUID, you can generate one from Powershell using new-guid or get one from this site: GUID Generator
